Chapter 5: Personal Transformation and the Ongoing Work of Antiracism.
Change almost never arrives in one big moment. Most of the time, it feels more like a collection of small shifts—each one building on the last. And honestly, that’s exactly how the journey toward antiracism unfolds.
It all starts with a bit of courage. The kind that lets you look at yourself honestly, question old beliefs, and stay open to new ways of seeing the world.
Picture this: maybe you’ve always thought of yourself as a fair-minded person—someone who treats everyone equally. But then, out of nowhere, you catch yourself making a snap judgment about a stranger, maybe just because of how they look. The thought flashes by quickly, but it sticks with you. You start to wonder—where did that even come from? And how many times has that kind of thought slipped by unnoticed?
The truth is, most of us don’t realize how deeply we’ve absorbed the messages our society sends about race. It’s not just about outright hatred or bigotry, but those subtle, everyday assumptions that quietly shape how we see ourselves and other people.
Unlearning these habits? It takes time. And effort. It means owning up to our mistakes, listening—really listening—to people whose experiences are different from our own, and being willing to keep trying, even when things get uncomfortable.
The process never really ends. There’s no finish line where you get to say, "I’m done, I’m officially antiracist." Every day brings fresh challenges, new chances to do better, and sometimes, a few setbacks. Some days feel easier than others, and that’s okay. What matters is that you keep going.
And here’s something important: this journey isn’t just personal. It’s collective, too. Real change calls for more than individual growth. It means coming together to build communities and movements—ones that can push for new policies, hold institutions accountable, and open up possibilities for everyone.
The work of antiracism isn’t about being perfect. It’s about being honest, sticking with it, and staying open to growth. It’s about realizing that everyone has a part to play, and that every step forward really does count.
The road is long, but every bit of progress is worth it.
